g.text: Eera — how the voice agent qualifies a lead
A browser call joins a LiveKit room, one SalesAgent listens and speaks, collects six fields turn by turn, then scores and saves the lead.
Deepgram STT · Groq LLM · Deepgram TTS ·
The model reads the transcript, chooses tools and
replies in two or three short sentences
Only the fields said in this turn are validated and
One question at a time → Deepgram TTS → the prospect
Score 0–100, set the priority band, write the record,
Read the summary back → close_call → the room
CONVERSATION RULES — six fields, in order
First name. Rejected if it is under
two characters or just a pronoun
Needs a digit or a money word (lakh,
crore, k, ₹). Parsed to INR, then
Needs a time word or a number: asap,
Email regex or a 7+ digit phone. A
10 if an email or phone was given, 0
The same four helpers compute lead_score in the saved record.
IN-MEMORY STATE — one SalesAgent per call
self._collected — every field captured so far, keyed by name
self._contact_refused — flips when the prospect explicitly declines
tool.agent — each function_tool reaches back to this instance
Prospect: "We need an e-commerce store, budget around 2 lakh, by next month."
→ extract_fields accepts service, budget and timeline.
→ missing = name, company, contact → Eera asks for the first name, then listens
Solid arrow — the main path, one step to the next.
Dashed arrow — this step calls a service or writes a record.
Glass sheet — a group of helpers, not a step of its own.
room + agent dispatch · one worker job per call · keep Render
STT nova-3, English, endpointing 300 ms · TTS aura-2-iris-en
gpt-oss-20b, tool_choice auto · extracts and replies in the
prewarmed per process · 0.4 s of silence ends the turn
validates this turn's values, merges them, returns collected +
only on an explicit refusal · drops contact from the missing
scores, sets priority, writes JSON + Supabase, returns the
returns closing: true · the room disconnects 2 s later
leads.json — append-only JSON on the backend · always written
Supabase leads — optional mirror · a failure never blocks the
GET /leads/{id} — detail page · 404 when the id is unknown
POST /chat — text mode · keyword extraction · one in-memory
Contact is optional — a refusal still saves the lead · contact
Bad values are spoken — the field stays missing and is asked
Eera · Zenx AI voice lead qualification — LiveKit Agents, Deepgram, Groq, FastAPI, Supabase and a Next.js dashboard.
